title: Sensor Removal Allowance Paid by Insurers on Repair Estimates & Appointments Teardowns
content:
**Allowance.** For the insurer's direct payment toward a Repair Estimates & Appointments teardown charge, the insurer adds a sensor allowance to its teardown allowance for driver-assistance sensors removed in the teardown. The allowance is read from the vehicle's ADAS Sensor Calibrations order in completed status and the systems it covered:

| Vehicle's completed network calibration order (ADAS Sensor Calibrations) | Sensor allowance |
|---|---|
| Covered multiple systems | 120.00 USD |
| Covered a single system | 70.00 USD |
| No completed calibration order | none |

The insurer adds 120.00 USD for a vehicle whose completed network calibration order covered multiple systems, 70.00 USD for one whose completed calibration order covered a single system, and none for a vehicle with no completed calibration order.

Hypothetical vehicles: a completed Dynamic Camera Calibration order covering the forward camera alone — 70.00 USD; a completed Multi-System Calibration order covering multiple systems — 120.00 USD; a calibration order that was declined — none.
